sentences.text: Asiahesperornis was a flightless bird with teeth that propelled itself through water by moving its feet.
It belongs to the group Hesperornithes, a collection of flightless, toothed seabirds from the Cretaceous, and is placed within the family Hesperornithidae.
Although its exact position is debated, it is likely a member of Hesperornithidae.
The genus was described by Nesov and Prizemlin in 1991 and is currently classified under the class Reptilia in the Paleobiology Database.
This animal lived between 83.6 and 66 million years ago along the shores of the ancient Turgai Sea in modern-day Kazakhstan.
